def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    annual_payment = 10_000
    interest_rate = 0.08
    periods = 5
    residual_value = 15_000

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    present_value = sum(
        annual_payment / ((1 + interest_rate) ** year)
        for year in range(1, periods + 1)
    )
    present_value += residual_value / ((1 + interest_rate) ** periods)
    answer = round(present_value)

    # Return answer
    return answer
